name: pr-radar
description: PR Radar: a band above the prompt with the state of your open PRs (who reviewed, who you wait for) and the PRs you are asked to review (reviewed or not), with a Refresh button and a details pane.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often to ask GitHub for the state of your PRs. The Refresh button asks at once.
